correctness.rationale: Using a fresh independent F4 incidence model, enumerated all 54,264 six-subsets of the 21 labelled projective points against all 21 lines, recovered 168 hyperovals, enumerated all 14,028 distinct pairs and constructed the full 40-regular intersection-3 graph. All finite cases are exhausted, no infinite generalization. Note historical literature already proves 168 and pair intersection valencies, so correctness not dependent on those being novel.
